' The selection process will be conducted by the District L€vel Selection Committee, Purulia. The District Heatth & Family Welfare

A candidate may apply for more than one pos! provided h€/she fulfils the eligibility criteria prescrib€d for each post. A candidate
shall submit only one online application for a particular post. Submission of more than one applicrtion for the same post by
the same candidate shall result in crncellation of all applications submitted for thrt post, and no further correspondence in

Mere inclusion of a candidate's name in the list of candidates called for Computer Tesvlnterview/Document Verification shall not

If at any stage of the recruitment process or during the period of engagement it is found that any information fumished by the
candidate is false, incorrect, misleading or that any document submitted by the candidate is forged./fabricated, his/her
candidature/engagement shall be cancelled forthwith, without prejudice to any other action that may be taken under the applicable
rules/law.
No TA,/DA shall be admissible to the candidates for appearing in the Computer Test, Written Test, lnterview, Document
Verification or any other stage ofthe recruitment process.
Selected candidates may be post€d at any health facilityiinstitution/unit under the administrative contsol of the District AYUSH
Samity/District Health & Family Welfare Samiti, as decided by the competent authority. No claim for posting at a particular place
shall be entertained.
Candidates shall be solely responsible for ensuring that all information entered in the online application is correct and complete.
Once the application is finally submitte4 no request for modification/correction shall be €ntertained. Candidates are advised Io
